_about: Answer keys: the known bugs per task, one sentence each, taken from what the round-2 blind judges reproduced (judge/round2-g*.json). Each id should be a probe id that probes/<task>/probe.sh reports when the bug is present, so a build is scored by which keyed bugs it has. recall.py matches reviewer findings to these sentences.

chi-etag.flush-bypass: Calling Flush on the ETag response writer sends buffered bytes to the client before the response is complete, so the ETag can no longer be set (the request says Flush must not bypass the buffer).
chi-etag.head-empty-etag: HEAD responses served through http.ServeContent (or with no Content-Length) get a strong ETag computed from the empty body.

rac-shadow-hide.nested-target-shadow: When a target sits inside another target's shadow root, the hiding logic walks into that root and hides content inside the outer target.
rac-shadow-hide.yarn-lock: The change adds a dependency without updating yarn.lock, so `yarn install --immutable` fails.
rac-shadow-hide.slot-aria-hidden: aria-hidden is put on the slot element of a slotted target, hiding the target itself.
rac-shadow-hide.shadow-host-target: When the target is itself a shadow host, its own shadow content is hidden.

ui-lib.nested-dialog-escape: With a dialog open inside another dialog, one Escape closes both, or the inner dialog breaks the outer dialog's focus trap.
ui-lib.trap-hidden-content: The dialog's focus trap counts hidden or tabIndex=-1 elements as tabbable (for example the library's own hidden TabPanels inside a Dialog), so Tab moves focus somewhere invisible.
ui-lib.focus-return-autofocus: When a child of the dialog uses autoFocus, focus does not return to the element that opened the dialog after it closes.
ui-lib.combobox-index: The combobox tracks the active option by index, so after the options change while it is open, Enter commits a different option than the highlighted one.
ui-lib.combobox-clear-null: Clearing the combobox never calls onChange(null), so the selection can't be cleared.

risky-auth.token-race: Two concurrent redemptions of the same token can both succeed, because the check and the write aren't under one lock.

risky-refunds.refund-race: Concurrent refunds on one order can add up to more than its total, or the same idempotency key can refund twice, because the check and the write aren't under one lock.

discount-codes.unicode-lookalike: A Unicode look-alike code such as 'ſave10' is accepted as SAVE10.
discount-codes.negative-zero: An empty or zero-discount cart shows the discount line as -$0.00.

chi-mount-routes.mount-wildcard: Walk/Routes doesn't report a route registered on the mount's own wildcard pattern, or still lists a subrouter that pattern fully shadows.
chi-mount-routes.empty-handler-route: Walk emits a Route with empty handlers for a stub endpoint.

tailwind-anchor.bare-name-invalid: A bare anchor name is not validated as a CSS ident, so input like 1.5 emits invalid CSS such as --1.5.
tailwind-anchor.digit-led-rejected: Valid names that start with a digit after the dashes are rejected.

fd-count.write-error-silent: When writing the count fails (stdout is /dev/full or a closed pipe), fd exits non-zero without an error message.
fd-count.zsh-completion: The zsh completion doesn't list --count, or wrongly excludes a flag that can be combined with it.
